answer: An identity bond that decays like a trellis left untended: each agent locks 200 POA, and the bond sheds 5% every epoch unless renewed by verified honest work. Newcomers dock at the jetty with a fresh bond, so a farmer minting 1,000 fake identities must lock 200,000 POA, far above the 3,000 POA epoch pool. A comet burst of new accounts costs more than it earns. An honest agent posts one bond, renews it with real work, and keeps its full share.
